highlights.description: Path checks that give the same answer on every platform: `fs.ValidatePath` no longer depends on `filepath.IsAbs`, `fs.IsAbsAny` reports a path that is absolute or rooted anywhere, and `fs.ValidateSlashPath` checks paths that use forward slashes everywhere

added.description: `fs.IsAbsAny(p)` reports whether a path is absolute or rooted on any platform: a leading `/` or `\`, a UNC path, or a drive letter, including the drive-relative `C:x`

`fs.ValidateSlashPath(p)` checks a relative path that uses forward slashes on every platform, such as one inside a repository, an archive or a URL; it also refuses backslashes, colons, and empty or `.` elements, reported as the new `fs.ErrInvalidPath`

changed.description: The path tests run every case on every platform instead of keeping absolute-path cases to the platform where each passed

fixed.description: `fs.ValidatePath` gives the same answer on every platform: it rejected `/etc/passwd` only off Windows, and accepted `\etc\passwd` and `\\server\share` off Windows

documentation.description: The fs guide explains which path check to use for a path on this machine, a path from elsewhere, and a forward-slash path; the portable-tests and getting-started guides, README and roadmap list the new functions; release notes for v0.8.0

highlights.description: File locking, directory sync and permission checks, so modules stop keeping platform-specific files of their own; and a test that enforces that oscompat has no dependencies

added.description: `fs.Lock(ctx, path)` takes an exclusive advisory lock between processes (`flock` on Unix, `LockFileEx` on Windows), waits until the context ends, and releases when the process exits; `fs.ErrLockUnsupported` on a platform with no locking
`fs.SyncDir(dir)` flushes a directory so a rename is durable, and does nothing where the platform offers no way to
`fs.PermissionsEnforced()`, `fs.IsPrivate`, `fs.CheckPrivate` (wrapping `fs.ErrNotPrivate`) and `fs.ChmodPrivate` for owner-only checks that are correct on Windows
A test that fails on any dependency, `go.sum` or import outside the standard library and the module, and package documentation stating the policy

changed.description: Portable-tests guide: use `fs.PermissionsEnforced()` for mode assertions, close handles in simulated-crash tests, and use `fs.Lock` and `fs.SyncDir`
A MkDocs site with a guide for each package, and release notes for v0.7.0; the `paths` documentation now matches the directories the code returns for cache, runtime and macOS system configuration

highlights.description: Process liveness, start time, and exec: detect a reused PID and hand the terminal to another program on Unix and Windows

added.description: `process.Exists(pid)` reports whether a process is running; a process owned by another user counts as running, and non-positive PIDs are rejected because they address process groups on Unix
`process.StartTime(pid)` returns when a process started (ps on Unix, process creation time on Windows) or `process.ErrNotFound`, so a stale record naming a reused PID can be detected
`process.Exec(path, argv)` replaces the current process on Unix and runs the program as a child that exits with its status on Windows

highlights.description: Cross-platform test utilities for home directory and duration assertions

added.description: `testutil.SetTempHomeDir()` sets both HOME and USERPROFILE for cross-platform home directory tests
`testutil.DurationNonNegative()` for Windows-safe duration checks (timer resolution ~15.6ms)
`testutil.AssertDurationNonNegative()` test helper for duration assertions
`testutil.WindowsTimerResolution` constant (16ms)

highlights.description: Cross-platform executable detection for file permission checks

added.description: `fs.IsExecutable()` for cross-platform executable file detection
`fs.IsExecutableInfo()` for executable detection with existing FileInfo

highlights.description: Breaking change: Capture functions now return errors for proper error handling

added.description: `fs.NormalizeLineEndings()` for CRLF to LF conversion

changed.description: **BREAKING**: `testutil.CaptureOutput()` now returns `(string, string, error)` instead of `(string, string)`

highlights.description: New testutil package for cross-platform stdout/stderr capture

added.description: `testutil.CaptureStdout()` for capturing stdout during function execution
`testutil.CaptureStderr()` for capturing stderr during function execution
`testutil.CaptureOutput()` for capturing both stdout and stderr

highlights.description: Initial release with cross-platform utilities for Go

added.description: `id` package: Cross-platform unique identifier generation using `crypto/rand`
`process` package: Cross-platform process management (detach, signal)
`paths` package: XDG-compliant config/data/cache directory resolution
`fs` package: Path validation, normalization, permissions, birthtime
`tsync` package: Tolerant timestamp comparison for file sync
`localnet` package: Cross-platform local IPC (Unix sockets / TCP)
